## EA Media Tools 2.6.0 - jaguar

### Streaming codec selection

- Streaming now uses HEVC Main for normal 4K and 1080p SDR output.
- HEVC Main10 is selected by default for HEVC Main10, HDR, and Dolby Vision sources when the active encoder supports 10-bit output.
- Automatic and explicit 720p or 360p Streaming output now switches to AV1 through validated per-tier codec defaults in `presets.ini`.

### Encoder-aware controls

- The Filters tab now shows an H.264 High-profile toggle whenever H.264 is selected; it defaults on and can be disabled per custom preset.
- Advanced video controls are filtered for the active encoder, and unsupported values are also blocked from the generated FFmpeg command.
- AV1 NVENC no longer shows or emits the unsupported B-frame-count option, while its supported multipass, B-reference, lookahead, scene-cut, non-reference-P, and AQ controls remain available.
- Codec-specific advanced-video overrides such as `b_frames_av1=0` can now be defined in `presets.ini`.

[Review changes since v2.5.1](https://github.com/eaforlife/media-converter/compare/v2.5.1...v2.6.0).
